title: Purchase drops quantity and promo_code; response shape crashes client post-payment
expected: >1 ticket issued with promo applied and {tickets[],total_kobo} returned | mobile client sends {tier_id,quantity,promo_code} and reads res.tickets.length
actual: exactly 1 ticket issued; promo_code silently dropped (bind reads 'promo'); response was a bare Ticket so res.tickets.length threw after the charge
root_cause: request struct never bound the shipped client fields; response type diverged from client contract

title: Gift ticket endpoint rejects the shipped client body (cashtag field)
actual: every gift 400s — binding required 'recipient' which the client never sends

title: GetEvent returns no tiers — buyers cannot see/select a ticket tier; live checkout crashes
actual: e.tiers is undefined in live mode → e.tiers.filter TypeError / empty tier list; tier_id unobtainable
root_cause: no member-facing tier read existed anywhere

title: Checkout shows a 1.5% 'Service fee' the backend never charges
actual: display adds subtotal*0.015 as a service fee; server debits only price×qty — buyer sees a fee that is never collected

title: Venue silently editable after tickets are sold despite module's own lock contract
expected: venue locked with date/time once tickets sell (per reasonHardTimeLocked text)
actual: venue patched under the soft-field guard — organiser could rewrite the purchased entitlement silently

title: No per-order or per-buyer ticket limit exists
expected: organiser-set min/max per order and cross-order per-buyer quota enforced
actual: no fields or checks exist; a buyer can place unlimited orders
root_cause: never modelled; needs schema columns (pending migration filed) + purchase-time count

title: PENDING checkouts never TTL-release for funded buyers (auto-charged by reconciler)
expected: abandoned hold expires and releases stock to other buyers
actual: sweep re-runs finalizePurchase: funded buyers get charged+ticketed regardless of age; only debit-refused orders expire

title: No manual lookup/check-in path for organisers
expected: gate staff can admit via order reference lookup with audit
actual: attendee roster is read-only; admission requires presenting the signed QR token

title: Offline scan acceptance/reconcile is unwired (server has the functions; nothing calls them)
expected: offline scans queued durably and reconciled server-side with dedup
actual: EnqueueOffline/Reconcile have no route or ticker caller; client optimistic-accepts offline without persisting a queue
root_cause: server-side offline path never wired; client fallback is advisory only

title: No transactional notifications on purchase/cancel/refund/reschedule
expected: booking confirmation; cancel+refund status; reschedule notice; reminders
actual: only manual Announce + realtime check-in push exist; nothing fires on lifecycle events
root_cause: notification seam only used by Announce

title: No customer-initiated refund flow (request/policy/cutoff/partial)
expected: self-service refund request with policy window and partial-ticket refunds
root_cause: refund surface never built beyond cancel sweep

title: Order self-service gaps: no orders endpoint/receipt/PDF/attendee fields/disputes
actual: MyTickets is the only self-service read; Ticket has no attendee fields; USED is terminal

title: No external payment rail for tickets (card/VA/webhook) — checkout is wallet-debit only
expected: sandbox card/VA payment with signed webhook settle
actual: all gateway cases unrunnable — no Paystack intent/webhook exists for ticket orders
root_cause: product rail is wallet-only by current design

title: Refund vs admission race has no precedence; a USED ticket is overwritten to REFUNDED
expected: configured precedence: cannot both admit and refund
actual: scan winning consume admits the buyer; the same ticket is then refunded and its state overwritten USED->REFUNDED
root_cause: refund sweep only skips revoke for non-ACTIVE creds; ticket flip is unconditional
